selection_rule: Only source choices already frozen and fresh-gated can enter. Compare those choices against the same v60 historical proxy. Within each task choose maximum mean CV gain minus 0.1 fold SD, evaluated leave-one-fold-out. If combined selector held mean <=0.001, retain the earliest source already accepted. Never sum improvements or tune fresh gains.
source_prediction_semantics: v61/v63/v65 task CV arrays are already raw family predictions; v62 multi-task arrays need graph/hybrid/rank-mean expansion separately within fold. Official valid not used for combined routing. v65 uses conditional official OTHER-assay covariates, separately disclosed.
test_baseline: Actual v60 CSV, never reconstructed historical test predictions
limitations: Historical proxy CV and repeated development labels; leave-fold routing is a stability diagnostic rather than unbiased nested validation. Source controls are not full historical ensemble. No official-score guarantee.
